scope: Source, latest hosted run, GitHub secret names, and existing token-file metadata only; no credential value, build, release, or dispatch inspected/run.
historical_blocker: Hosted run 36820858912 stopped before checkout: Missing required release secrets: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN. The name was absent when this review began; the other seven required names were present.
real_requirement: release.sh blocks on check:migrations:strict and catalog:tools:drift:strict. Both require verified live DB reads. The publishable REST path may suffice for some rows, but the migration ledger and private tool/bundle metadata have Management API fallbacks; removing verification entirely would weaken a real gate.
unnecessary_restriction: The hosted workflow's sbp_fc prefix check was added separately in e551eef2. Supabase documents both classic and scoped PATs as Management API credentials; scoped is recommended for CI, but the read-only query endpoint and helper do not require a scoped-token prefix. The prefix check is an extra local policy obstacle, not a functional release requirement.
existing_access: A mode-0600 ~/.supabase/access-token exists and is the instructed noninteractive CLI credential. The parent privately verified HTTP 200 and matching project identity from the official Management API project endpoint, then provisioned that same existing credential as the repository's SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN GitHub secret through stdin; no value was printed, rotated, or newly granted. Database Read permission and the strict gate outcome remain unverified.
narrow_correction: Implemented: removed only the sbp_fc prefix rejection from .github/workflows/release.yml; kept the nonempty secret requirement, strict migration/tool checks, and Management API read-only SELECT validation. No rotation or new grant is intrinsically required if an existing authorized token can read the project.
gate_verification: Executed the extracted workflow bash gate using synthetic classic, scoped, and empty token strings: classic/scoped exit 0, empty exits 1 with the missing-secret finding. Confirmed both strict live-DB gate commands remain in release.sh.
hosted_red: Hosted run 37092816878 passed credential preflight and both checkouts, then pnpm/action-setup@v4 failed before installation: No pnpm version is specified. Its log shows package_json_file: package.json, while this workflow checks out the extension at matrx-extend/package.json (whose packageManager is pnpm@10.30.3).
hosted_setup_repair: Configured pnpm/action-setup@v4 package_json_file: matrx-extend/package.json as the v4 action.yml documents for nested checkouts. Added astral-sh/setup-uv@v5 before release because scripts/generate-records-guide.ts invokes uv run python during mandatory artifact regeneration; CI already installs the same action. setup-node cache path and command working directories already point to matrx-extend.
hosted_package_red: Hosted run 37093086895 passed credential preflight, pnpm/uv setup, installation, and entered release.sh; its first strict check rejected stale @ai-matrx packages for v0.2.176. Nothing was published. The host log reported only the check name, exit 1, and remedy.
hosted_package_repair: After frozen installation and before release.sh, the hosted workflow now runs the existing pnpm sync:matrx-packages command with normal package/version diagnostics, stages only package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml, commits them locally if changed, and rejects any remaining uncommitted paths. release.sh assembles its candidate from committed trees, reruns the package freshness gate, and atomically publishes only a fully validated candidate; no raw release log is uploaded on failure.
independent_review_repair: HR-1: release.sh now emits and saves an ignored sanitized diagnosis log for strict checks; @ai-matrx failures include only parsed package names and version fields, and lint failures include whitelisted paths/rules. The hosted workflow uploads only that sanitized file on failure under a run-unique name; validated ZIP/receipt upload stays success-only. HR-2: before each generation/check/build loop, release.sh compares the merged candidate's manifest (excluding version only), lockfile, pnpm workspace/config, and patches with LOCAL_HEAD, whose dependencies the hosted runner installed. Any changed input stops before snapshotting the candidate, including after a remote push race.
hosted_lint_red: Hosted run 37093887750 passed the refreshed shared-package gate, then stopped at lint for candidate v0.2.176 before publication. Concurrent main CI 37093887851 passed lint, so the failing bytes differ in the release candidate; the prior sanitized artifact carried only gate/exit/candidate and cannot establish the exact file/rule. The release script now reruns Biome JSON only after a lint failure and emits tracked relative paths, rule categories, and generic messages; sourceCode, advice, and raw diagnostics are omitted.
version_only_retry_correction: The strict dependency guard initially compared all package.json bytes. After a release push succeeds but local ZIP promotion fails, remote main has only a version bump and the checkout remains at the earlier HEAD. That stopped the fixture before its intended ZIP-restoration assertion. The guard now ignores only package.json version while comparing every other manifest field, the lockfile, pnpm config/workspace, and patches.
retry_peer_repair: Independent review 75d5cad9 found relative Biome paths could be resolved against the release checkout instead of CHECK_SNAP and therefore suppressed. The safe parser now resolves relative paths against CHECK_SNAP before applying its traversal/character whitelist. The existing ship-path fixture now injects a relative-path Biome JSON error with synthetic sourceCode and checks that the safe path/rule appears while sourceCode does not; it also checks successful release after a version-only post-push promotion failure and refusal before validation when a later remote commit changes another manifest field.
hosted_lint_cause_and_repair: Hosted run 37094898802 safely identified exactly one lint failure: src/lib/tools/generated/records-guide.json format differs. The generator wrote Python's json.dumps(indent=2) bytes directly, which are not guaranteed to match this repo's Biome JSON line-width rules; checked-in source lint therefore passed while regeneration changed the candidate. The generator now pipes the pinned server projection through Biome format with the canonical guide file path before both write and --check comparison. The parity test also independently asserts the checked-in guide is Biome-clean.
remaining_verification: The focused assertion has been corrected after actual hosted failure evidence. A coordinated hosted retry must verify regenerated candidate tests and all subsequent release gates; no release was published by run 37095965467. Mac local heavy verification remains under the disk guard.
hosted_unit_red: Hosted run 37095276034 cleared lint after the records-guide formatter repair, then stopped at unit-tests for candidate v0.2.176 before publication. Parallel main CI run 37095276203 on dd1dcd94acfe2156019ce2e79b93660b568488ae passed. The candidate test failure is not identified by the prior gate-only artifact; candidate-only generation/package inputs or a runner-specific failure remain possible.
unit_diagnostic_repair: On a unit-tests failure, release.sh now extracts only whitelisted Vitest failed test file paths and titles matching literal static labels in the candidate test source into the already-sanitized diagnostics artifact. Assertions, runtime values, and raw test output remain private. Synthetic Vitest lines proved the recognized file/label is emitted and an unknown title is omitted; bash syntax passed. This is diagnostic only; the unit gate still blocks release.
unit_hosted_output_correction: Parent ruling after candidate-only unit failure: release.sh now prints the ordinary captured Vitest failure output into the hosted job log, replacing every configured credential environment value and JSON-escaped equivalent before printing. No environment dump or raw output artifact is added; the already-sanitized artifact remains file/static-label only, and the unit gate remains blocking. A synthetic credential was absent from printed output while ordinary failure context remained; bash syntax and diff checks passed.
hosted_unit_cause: Hosted run 37095965467 on b6f1f472 reached the strict unit gate and failed exactly one of 1,918 active tests: tests/unit/records-handler.test.ts, unknown guide topic vocabulary. The pinned server regenerated canonical unknown-guide note now says Call {"action": "guide", "args": {"topic": "<action>"}}, while the test hard-coded the older direct topic shape. Handler behavior uses canonicalGuide.unknown.note and correctly returned the new text; main CI passed only because its checked-in guide still had old text. No candidate was published.
hosted_unit_repair: The test now derives its expected note from canonicalGuide.unknown.note and substitutes the canonical unknown_topic_quoted marker with the requested unknown topic. This retains exact server-guide text and substitution verification while allowing the pinned server to change call syntax. No release gate or runtime handler was weakened.
